ravi: Quick note from onboarding tests: payments sampleapp saw duplicate side-effects when SDK retried after 429s during token rotation. Minimal repro in CI.
emily: Can you paste the essential logs?
ravi: logs: WARN attempt=1 429 retry_after=0.4s 
INFO attempt=2 got 200 -> charge=ch_A 
INFO attempt=2 processed -> charge=ch_B
emily: Both retries returned 200 and backend created two charges. Do we send Idempotency-Key header?
ravi: No, sampleapp only includes a body request_id generated per request, so a retry regenerates it.
emily: Short-term: change sampleapp to persist request_id across retries. Medium-term: SDK should offer auto-inject Idempotency-Key for mutating calls with opt-out. Also switch to full jitter backoff (base_ms=500) to avoid clumping when token refreshes.
ci-bot: CI run #1423 shows 4/100 runs with duplicates before sampleapp patch.
ravi: I'll open a tiny sampleapp PR that stashes request_id in the retry context. Emily, can you prototype the SDK change? Make it opt-out via env var and emit an anonymized telemetry event when enabled. Also add config `safeReplayWindowMs` server-side docs so teams know TTL for dedupe.
emily: Sounds good. I'll draft SDK PR: defaults: autoIdempotency=true, autoIdempotencyEnv=REDWOOD_SDK_AUTOIDEMPOTENCY=false, backoff.strategy=full_jitter, backoff.base_ms=500. Tag security for header retention concerns.
ravi: Great. After canary roll we'll run the CI harness with token TTL forced low. If dupes drop to zero we merge.
emily: Also updating onboarding docs with a short note: "If you mutate state, ensure request id stable across retries or rely on SDK Idempotency-Key."
ci-bot: Canary deploy of sdk@canary-20260323 initiated for sampleapp tests.
ravi: Thanks team, will link PRs here when ready.
